note: The circuit manifest (ADR-0003). This is the single place a circuit is declared:
adding one means adding an entry here, never editing scripts/trace_track_limits.html.
Every path is relative to this file's directory. `mosaic` is gitignored build output —
regenerate it with scripts/build_<name>_mosaic.sh, which emits `sidecar` in the same breath.
`half_width_m` is the constant half-width the seeding step offsets the Centerline by; it is
a starting guess for dragging, not a measurement, and a seed is explicitly not a track limit.
JSON has no comment syntax, hence this key — scripts/trace.py ignores it.
